title: Industrial ReMEmbR: Scaling Spatiotemporal Memory to Robot Fleets
title_zh: Industrial ReMEmbR：将时空记忆扩展至机器人机群

paragraphs.en: Warehouse robot fleets continuously observe operational conditions, but preserving these observations as reusable semantic memory incurs substantial computation, communication, and storage costs. For example, explaining recurring aisle blockages can require reviewing video from multiple robots across several shifts. We present Industrial ReMEmbR , a shared spatiotemporal memory system that extends NVIDIA ReMEmbR to robot fleets and reduces server-side computation by generating scene descriptions only on demand. On each robot, an NVIDIA Jetson encodes video clips into retrieval embeddings with Cosmos-Embed1, vision tokens with Cosmos3-Edge, and reconstruction latents with the Wan2.2 VAE, without uploading raw camera frames. The encoding models are re-used to detect people in image patches, zeroing them out to support PII abstraction for GDPR-compliant deployments. We split Cosmos3-Edge at its vision–language boundary, placing the vision encoder on the robot and the language decoder on an on-premises server. A Nemotron agent retrieves memories by content, position, and time and queries the decoder using cached vision tokens. This design eliminates caption generation at write time, while cached-token decoding reproduces the unsplit model’s output in all 450 tested decodes. On the NaVQA benchmark, the updated model stack achieves comparable retrieval recall while reducing unparsable answers from 4.5% to 1.9% with an agent half the parameter size. We further demonstrate a live semantic traffic map that classifies aisle conditions directly from retrieval embeddings. Across 914 simulated warehouse frames, this method exceeds the best caption-based alternative by 6.0 percentage points. By decoupling memory encoding from description, Industrial ReMEmbR transforms a fleet’s collective experience into an extensible foundation for spatial and temporal reasoning, including faithful scene reconstruction, context-guided elaboration, and semantic mapping of dynamic warehouse conditions as they unfold.

paragraphs.en: An embodied memory lets a robot recall what it has seen, where, and when, long after the moment has passed. NVIDIA’s ReMEmbR ( Anwar et al., 2025 ) , a spatiotemporal memory system designed for long-horizon visual question answering for robot navigation, showed that a single robot can build such a memory from its own camera stream. On a warehouse floor, however, that robot is only one of many. A fleet management system, or fleet manager, continuously tracks dozens of autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) and other integrated devices in a modern warehouse, assigning them orders and planning their routes over VDA5050, the standard interface between mobile robots and fleet management systems. Obstacles outside the tracking system are left to each robot’s intelligent navigation system to recognize and avoid. What a passing robot sees is rarely kept, because continuously uploading and storing raw video from every robot is expensive, so the rich semantic context of each scene never reaches the rest of the fleet.
paragraphs.zh: 具身记忆让机器人在某一时刻过去很久之后，仍能回忆起它看到了什么、在哪里、何时看到。 NVIDIA 的 ReMEmbR（Anwar 等，2025）是一个面向机器人导航长时程视觉问答的时空记忆系统，它证明了单个机器人可以从自身的摄像头视频流中构建这样的记忆。 然而，在仓库现场，这台机器人只是众多机器人中的一台。 车队管理系统（或称车队管理器）在现代仓库中持续追踪数十台自主移动机器人（AMR）及其他集成设备，通过 VDA5050——移动机器人与车队管理系统之间的标准接口——为它们分配订单并规划路线。 追踪系统之外的障碍物则交给每台机器人的智能导航系统去识别和避让。 路过的机器人所看到的内容很少被保留，因为持续上传并存储每台机器人的原始视频代价高昂，因此每个场景丰富的语义上下文永远无法传达给车队中的其他机器人。

paragraphs.en: To illustrate, consider the case of a fleet management system that keeps routing AMRs through an aisle partially blocked by a clutter of untracked obstacles. Each robot independently maneuvers around the clutter, losing time before carrying on with its scheduled tasks. A few days later, a human operator reviewing the daily logs notices that task completion times slipped that day, but has no record of the scene from which to trace its root cause. Neither the fleet manager nor the operator has the semantic context that could have prevented the congestion, by adaptively routing later robots away from the aisle, or its recurrence, by revealing what caused it.
paragraphs.zh: 举例来说，设想一个车队管理系统，它不断引导自动移动机器人（AMR）穿过一条被未追踪障碍物杂乱堵塞的通道。 每个机器人都独立地在杂物间绕行，在继续执行其计划任务之前损失了时间。 几天后，一名人工操作员在查看每日日志时发现当天的任务完成时间有所延迟，但却没有任何该场景的记录来追溯其根本原因。 无论是车队管理者还是操作员，都缺乏可以在当时通过自适应地将后续机器人改道避开该通道来防止拥堵、或在事后通过揭示其原因来避免复发的语义上下文。

paragraphs.en: Closing this contextual blind spot requires scaling embodied memory from a single robot to the entire fleet, with every connected robot acting as a live reporter from the warehouse floor that continuously contributes its observations, tagged with location and time, to a shared fleet memory. In the scenario above, the first robot to encounter the clutter would report it on a live semantic map, letting the fleet manager route subsequent robots around the blocked aisle. Days later, the operator could ask the fleet’s shared semantic memory what caused the reroutes and receive an answer grounded in direct visual observation: when and where the clutter appeared, and what it consisted of. The same record can supply the world state of a centralized planner such as RobotFleet ( Gupta et al., 2025 ) , which schedules heterogeneous robots from declarative statements about the site and replans when a robot reports a discovery.
paragraphs.zh: 要弥合这一情境盲区，需要把具身记忆从单个智能体扩展到整个智能体机群，让每一台联网的智能体都充当来自仓库现场的实时报告者，持续贡献其观测结果，并附带位置和时间标签，汇入共享的机群记忆。 在上述场景中，第一台遇到杂乱堆积物的智能体会将其报告到实时语义地图上，使机群管理者能够引导后续智能体绕开被堵塞的通道。 数天之后，操作员可以询问机群的共享语义记忆是什么导致了改道，并获得一个基于直接视觉观测的答案：杂乱堆积物何时何地出现，以及它由什么构成。 同样的记录还能为集中式规划器（如 RobotFleet（Gupta 等，2025））提供世界状态，这类规划器根据关于场站的声明式陈述来调度异构智能体，并在某台智能体报告发现时重新规划。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we build on ReMEmbR, which captions each short video clip, stores the caption along with the robot’s time and location and a corresponding caption embedding, and lets an agentic model perform semantic retrieval over the vector database to answer arbitrary questions. Scaling this design from one robot to a fleet breaks three of its assumptions, and each break motivates one principle of our design. First, ReMEmbR generates a caption for every clip as it is written, so its cost grows with every robot added and every hour it operates, and continuously uploading raw video from every robot is costly to begin with. We therefore encode once , compressing each clip on the robot’s own edge compute into compact representations that every later step reuses. Second, ReMEmbR answers occasional questions, whereas the fleet manager also needs a continuously updated view of the site. We therefore interpret continuously , reading that state directly from each memory as it arrives, without generating any text. Third, the questions a memory must answer are not known when it is first encoded. We therefore elaborate on demand , deferring any description of a scene until a question about it arrives. In the blocked aisle example, the clutter is encoded once by the first robot that passes it, flagged on the live map as soon as its memory arrives, and described in detail only when the operator asks about it days later.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们在 ReMEmbR 的基础上进行构建，ReMEmbR 会为每个短视频片段生成字幕，将字幕连同机器人的时间和位置以及相应的字幕嵌入存储起来，并让一个智能体模型在向量数据库上执行语义检索以回答任意问题。 将这一设计从单台机器人扩展到机器人编队会破坏其三个假设，而每一处破坏都促成了我们设计中的一个原则。 首先，ReMEmbR 在每个片段被写入时就为其生成字幕，因此其成本会随着每台新增机器人和每小时的运行而增长，而且让每台机器人持续上传原始视频本身就是昂贵的。 因此，我们进行一次编码，在机器人自身的边缘算力上将每个片段压缩为紧凑的表示，供后续每个步骤复用。 其次，ReMEmbR 回答的是偶发性问题，而编队管理者还需要一个持续更新的现场视图。 因此，我们进行持续解读，在每条记忆到达时直接从中读取状态，而不生成任何文本。 第三，一条记忆需要回答的问题在它首次被编码时是未知的。 因此，我们进行按需细化，将任何对场景的描述推迟到相关问题到来之时。 在被堵塞的过道示例中，杂物由第一台经过的机器人编码一次，在其记忆到达后立即在实时地图上被标记，并且只在操作员数天后询问时才被详细描述。

sents.zh: 在被堵塞的过道示例中，杂物由第一台经过的机器人编码一次，在其记忆到达后立即在实时地图上被标记，并且只在操作员数天后询问时才被详细描述。

paragraphs.en: We present Industrial ReMEmbR (Fig. 1 ), a shared memory system built around these three principles. It encodes clips on edge compute across the fleet, continuously aggregates and interprets them on server compute for live semantic mapping, and elaborates on any of them on demand. Each robot’s onboard Jetson edge-compute device runs iw.encode , the edge component for efficient multi-purpose encoding. This deployed service continuously generates video-text embedding vectors for memory retrieval derived from Cosmos-Embed1 ( NVIDIA, 2025 ) , vision tokens for optional scene description derived from the detached vision encoder of Cosmos3-Edge ( NVIDIA, 2026a ) , and compressed latent frames for optional scene inspection generated by the Wan2.2 VAE ( Team Wan, 2025b ; Team Wan, 2025a ) encoder. Only the aforementioned multi-purpose scene representations, robot pose and memory timestamp are uploaded into a shared fleet memory, whose vector index is accelerated with NVIDIA cuVS ( RAPIDS Team, 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出Industrial ReMEmbR（图1），一个围绕这三项原则构建的共享记忆系统。 它在整个机群中的边缘计算设备上对视频片段进行编码，在服务器计算资源上持续聚合和解释这些片段以实现实时语义建图，并可根据需要对任意片段进行细化处理。 每台机器人的机载Jetson边缘计算设备运行iw.encode，这是用于高效多用途编码的边缘组件。 这项已部署的服务持续生成以下内容：用于记忆检索的视频-文本嵌入向量，其源自Cosmos-Embed1（NVIDIA，2025）；用于可选场景描述的视觉token，其源自Cosmos3-Edge（NVIDIA，2026a）分离的视觉编码器；以及用于可选场景检查的压缩潜在帧，其由Wan2.2 VAE（Team Wan，2025b；Team Wan，2025a）编码器生成。 只有前述的多用途场景表征、机器人位姿和记忆时间戳会被上传到共享的机群记忆中，其向量索引由NVIDIA cuVS（RAPIDS Team，2024）加速。

paragraphs.en: To reduce server-side computation, we generate scene descriptions and answers on demand for memories retrieved by the agent, rather than captioning every encoded clip. We enable this by splitting Cosmos3-Edge at its vision–language boundary, where its server-side language decoder answers questions from cached vision tokens without accessing or re-encoding the original clips. We deploy a Nemotron-3-Nano-4B ( NVIDIA, 2026b ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ) agent through an NVIDIA NIM inference microservice to retrieve memories by content, position, and time, and optionally query the decoder with a text prompt and the retrieved vision tokens. Operators can also reconstruct scenes from stored latent frames for visual inspection. On NaVQA, Upgraded ReMEmbR , our version of ReMEmbR updated with the NVIDIA models and a video-based index, achieves comparable retrieval recall while reducing unparseable answers from 4.5% to 1.9% with an agent half the parameter size.
paragraphs.zh: 为了减少服务器端计算量，我们按需为智能体检索到的记忆生成场景描述和答案，而不是对每个已编码的视频片段都生成字幕。 我们通过在 Cosmos3-Edge 的视觉-语言边界处对其进行拆分来实现这一点，其服务器端语言解码器可以从缓存的视觉 token 回答问题，而无需访问或重新编码原始视频片段。 我们通过 NVIDIA NIM 推理微服务部署一个 Nemotron-3-Nano-4B（NVIDIA, 2026b；NVIDIA et al., 2025）智能体，以按内容、位置和时间检索记忆，并可选择使用文本提示和检索到的视觉 token 查询解码器。 运维人员还可以从存储的潜在帧重建场景，以便进行视觉检查。 在 NaVQA 上，Upgraded ReMEmbR——即我们使用 NVIDIA 模型和基于视频的索引更新后的 ReMEmbR 版本——在检索召回率相当的情况下，将无法解析的答案比例从 4.5% 降至 1.9%，且所用智能体的参数量仅为原来的一半。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate the system through a live semantic traffic map that communicates observed aisle conditions to the fleet manager. We classify each robot’s latest observation by comparing its retrieval embedding with paired text prompts describing occupied and clear aisles. A map service periodically queries the agent for these classifications and updates predefined semantic zones using robot poses already reported to the fleet manager over VDA5050. In a simulated warehouse, this approach achieves 71.3% balanced accuracy, exceeding the best caption-based alternative evaluated with the same models by 6.0 percentage points. We deploy each model as a modular service to support future extensions for station-readiness checks, landmark-based navigation guidance for deployed policy models, and curation of diverse preprocessed training data (Section 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过一个实时语义交通地图来演示该系统，该地图将观测到的通道状况传达给车队管理者。 我们通过将每个机器人最新的观测结果与描述通道被占用和畅通状态的成对文本提示的检索嵌入进行比较，来对其进行分类。 地图服务会定期向智能体查询这些分类结果，并利用已通过 VDA5050 上报给车队管理者的机器人位姿来更新预定义的语义区域。 在一个模拟仓库中，该方法达到了 71.3% 的平衡准确率，比使用相同模型评估的、基于描述的最佳替代方案高出 6.0 个百分点。 我们将每个模型部署为模块化服务，以支持未来的扩展功能，包括站点就绪性检查、为已部署的策略模型提供基于地标的导航引导，以及多样化预处理训练数据的整理（第 7 节）。

Retrieval is no longer bottlenecked by what a captioner chose to mention, and a smaller, tool-calling agent returns more reliable structured answers (Section 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 视频原生的智能体记忆。 我们在一个高效的 NVIDIA 模型栈上重建了 ReMEmbR，并将其索引键从字幕文本迁移到视频本身。 检索不再被字幕生成器选择提及的内容所瓶颈，而一个更小的、可调用工具的智能体能返回更可靠的结构化答案（第 3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Industrial ReMEmbR builds on three main lines of research: large language model (LLM) agents that support versatile tool use, retrieval-augmented generation from semantic embeddings, and the ReMEmbR system, which combines the two to encode and query a robot’s memories over long horizons.
paragraphs.zh: 工业级 ReMEmbR 建立在三个主要研究方向之上：支持多样化工具使用的大语言模型（LLM）智能体、基于语义嵌入的检索增强生成，以及将两者结合以在长时程上编码和查询机器人记忆的 ReMEmbR 系统。

paragraphs.en: Agents. In this context, an agent is an LLM that runs in an interactive loop with access to predefined tools. At each step in the loop, the model reads the task and its own running history, and then either calls any of the available tools or provides its final answer. ReAct ( Yao et al., 2023 ) features the model writing out its intermediate reasoning between tool calls, so that the result of one call guides the next. Practically, every tool call must be well-formatted to allow for deterministic parsing and automated execution. The loop also needs a limit on the allowed number of steps, so that it always ends with a concrete answer. Industrial ReMEmbR follows this loop, and adds a tool that lets the agent ask a vision–language decoder its own question about any memory it retrieves.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体。 在此语境下，智能体是一个在交互循环中运行、可访问预定义工具的大语言模型（LLM）。 在循环的每一步，模型读取任务及其自身的运行历史，然后要么调用任一可用工具，要么给出最终答案。 ReAct（Yao et al., 2023）的特点是模型在工具调用之间写出其中间推理，使一次调用的结果能指导下一次调用。 实际上，每次工具调用都必须格式正确，以便进行确定性解析和自动化执行。 循环还需要对允许的步骤数设置上限，从而总能以一个明确的答案结束。 工业级 ReMEmbR 遵循这一循环，并增加了一个工具，让智能体能够向视觉–语言解码器就其检索到的任意记忆提出自己的问题。

sents.en: The loop also needs a limit on the allowed number of steps, so that it always ends with a concrete answer.

sents.en: Industrial ReMEmbR follows this loop, and adds a tool that lets the agent ask a vision–language decoder its own question about any memory it retrieves.
sents.zh: 工业级 ReMEmbR 遵循这一循环，并增加了一个工具，让智能体能够向视觉–语言解码器就其检索到的任意记忆提出自己的问题。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-augmented generation. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) allows a model to derive answers from a corpus even if it is too large to directly fit in context. The corpus is chunked and indexed in advance, and for each question the k k most relevant chunks are retrieved and incorporated in the model’s context window. Retrieval is usually done with a bi-encoder , which embeds queries and documents separately so that search involves a fast vector comparison ( Karpukhin et al., 2020 ) . The trade-off is that every document vector is computed before any query is known. A cross-encoder , by contrast, reads a query and a document together, which tends to be more accurate but often too slow to apply to a whole corpus, so it normally only re-ranks a shortlist already retrieved ( Nogueira and Cho, 2019 ) by the bi-encoder. Agentic RAG ( Singh et al., 2025 ) exposes retrieval as a tool for the agent. The agent writes its own retrieval queries, retries upon search misses, and decides when it has sufficient evidence to return with a contextually grounded response. Industrial ReMEmbR uses agentic RAG over video instead of text, with a video–text bi-encoder as the index and a decoder that reads the question and the retrieved memory together.
paragraphs.zh: 检索增强生成。 检索增强生成（RAG）（Lewis et al., 2020）允许模型从语料库中得出答案，即使该语料库大到无法直接放入上下文。 语料库会被预先分块并建立索引，对于每个问题，系统会检索出 k k 个最相关的文本块，并将其纳入模型的上下文窗口。 检索通常使用双编码器完成，它分别对查询和文档进行嵌入，从而可以通过快速的向量比较来进行搜索（Karpukhin et al., 2020）。 其代价是每个文档向量都必须在知道任何查询之前预先计算。 相比之下，交叉编码器将查询和文档一起读取，这通常更准确，但往往太慢而无法应用于整个语料库，因此它通常只对双编码器已检索出的候选列表进行重排（Nogueira and Cho, 2019）。 智能体式 RAG（Singh et al., 2025）将检索作为工具暴露给智能体。 智能体自行编写检索查询，在搜索未命中时重试，并决定何时已拥有足够的证据，从而返回一个有上下文依据的回答。 工业 ReMEmbR 在视频而非文本上使用智能体式 RAG，以视频–文本双编码器作为索引，并使用一个将问题和检索到的记忆一起读取的解码器。

paragraphs.en: ReMEmbR. ReMEmbR ( Anwar et al., 2025 ) lets a user ask a mobile robot where something is, when something happened, or what it saw over hours of operation, and returns answers the robot can act on, such as an ( x , y , z ) (x,y,z) position to navigate toward. paragraphs.en: It works in two phases. In the memory-building phase, VILA ( Lin et al., 2024 ) captions each 3 s video segment, MxBai ( Lee et al., 2024 ) embeds the caption, and Milvus ( Wang et al., 2021 ) stores the embedding with the segment’s mean position and time. 1 1 1 Position and orientation are stored in separate columns. In the querying phase, an LLM agent searches this memory by text, position or time for up to three rounds, and then returns a structured JSON answer that holds text, a yes/no value, a time, a duration or a goal position. The accompanying NaVQA benchmark contains 210 questions over seven CODa sequences ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) of 15 to 30 minutes each. A position answer counts as correct within 15 m, and a time answer within 2 min.
paragraphs.zh: 它分为两个阶段运行。 在记忆构建阶段，VILA（Lin et al., 2024）为每个 3 秒的视频片段生成字幕，MxBai（Lee et al., 2024）对该字幕进行向量化嵌入，Milvus（Wang et al., 2021）则将该嵌入与片段的平均位置和时间一同存储。1 1 1 位置和朝向分别存储在不同的列中。 在查询阶段，一个 LLM 智能体通过文本、位置或时间在该记忆中检索，最多进行三轮，然后返回一个结构化的 JSON 答案，其中包含文本、是/否值、时间、时长或目标位置。 配套的 NaVQA 基准包含 210 个问题，覆盖七段每段 15 至 30 分钟的 CODa 序列（Zhang et al., 2024）。 位置答案在 15 米以内视为正确，时间答案在 2 分钟以内视为正确。

paragraphs.en: In ReMEmbR, a caption does two jobs. It serves as the index key , since its text embedding decides which questions can find the clip, and it serves as the context , since it is all the agent reads once the memory is retrieved. Both jobs depend on what the captioner chose to mention when first encoding. “A forklift in a warehouse” may be accurate but still leave out whether the forklift blocks the aisle, in which case a question about blocked aisles becomes less likely to align with the caption’s embedding. Captioning is therefore an information bottleneck for retrieval, since a scene detail has to survive both the captioner’s limited attention and the embedding step to play any role in the search. To build toward Industrial ReMEmbR , we first introduce Upgraded ReMEmbR . It keeps ReMEmbR’s pipeline, updates its underlying models, and moves the index key from the caption to the video itself, circumventing the retrieval bottleneck.
paragraphs.zh: 在 ReMEmbR 中，字幕承担两项职责。 它既是索引键，因为其文本嵌入决定了哪些问题能找到对应片段；也是上下文，因为记忆被检索后，智能体读到的只有这段字幕。 这两项职责都取决于字幕生成器在初次编码时选择提及的内容。「仓库里的一辆叉车」可能准确，但仍可能漏掉叉车是否挡住通道这一信息；在这种情况下，关于通道被堵的问题就不太可能与该字幕的嵌入对齐。 因此，字幕生成是检索的信息瓶颈，因为一个场景细节必须既经受住字幕生成器有限的注意力，又通过嵌入步骤，才能在搜索中发挥作用。 为了逐步构建 Industrial ReMEmbR，我们先介绍 Upgraded ReMEmbR。 它保留了 ReMEmbR 的流程，更新了其底层模型，并将索引键从字幕转移到视频本身，从而绕过这一检索瓶颈。

paragraphs.en: Upgraded ReMEmbR retains ReMEmbR’s three-second segments, its position and time metadata, and its search by content, position and time, so that any change on NaVQA can be attributed to the models. Two of the three model updates are direct replacements. Cosmos3-Edge ( NVIDIA, 2026a ) takes over captioning from VILA-1.5-13B ( Lin et al., 2024 ) . It is roughly one-third the size, and its emphasis on physical-world and spatial understanding suits questions about how a scene is arranged. Nemotron-3-Nano-4B ( NVIDIA, 2026b ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ) takes over the agent role from Llama-3.1-8B ( Grattafiori and others, 2024 ) , ReMEmbR’s locally hosted agent. It is a hybrid Mamba-Transformer model with half the parameters, post-trained for tool use and structured output, and it has access to the same search tools as before.

paragraphs.en: Three principles guide the design. The first is to encode once . Each clip passes through the robot’s encoders a single time and comes out as the representations that later steps read: an embedding for retrieval, vision tokens for description, and a video latent for inspection. No later step has to return to the camera frames, which never need to leave the robot. Per-clip work therefore runs on the robot, and its cost grows with the length of the footage. The second is to interpret continuously . The server scores each incoming embedding as it arrives, which keeps the live semantic map current without generating any text. The third is to elaborate on demand . Text is generated once a question is known, so it can address that question, and the same memory can be described again for the next one. Per-question work therefore runs on the server, and its cost grows with the number of questions asked rather than with the amount of video recorded. The following subsections follow these principles in turn: encode once on the robot (Section 4.1 ), interpret continuously on the memory the robots feed (Section 4.2 ), and elaborate on demand on the server (Section 4.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 三项原则指导本设计。 第一项是一次编码。 每个视频片段只经过机器人的编码器一次，输出为后续步骤所读取的表示：用于检索的嵌入、用于描述的视觉 token，以及用于检查的视频潜变量。 后续步骤无需返回相机帧，相机帧永远不需要离开机器人。 因此，逐片段的处理在机器人上运行，其开销随视频时长增长。 第二项是持续解读。 服务器在每条嵌入到达时即对其进行评分，从而在不生成任何文本的情况下保持实时语义地图的最新状态。 第三项是按需细化。 文本只在已知问题之后才生成，因此可以针对该问题作答，而同一段记忆也可以针对下一个问题再次被描述。 因此，逐问题的处理在服务器上运行，其开销随提问数量而非录制视频量增长。 以下小节依次遵循这些原则：在机器人上一次编码（第 4.1 节），对机器人所提供的记忆进行持续解读（第 4.2 节），以及在服务器上按需细化（第 4.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Cosmos-Embed1 maps the segment to a single 768-dimensional vector in a shared video–text space, which takes 3 kB. paragraphs.en: Fleet memory has two parts, matched to how each kind of data is used. Every segment adds one row to a shared Milvus collection ( Wang et al., 2021 ) , containing its Cosmos-Embed1 vector, the robot’s pose, the capture time and any verdict the server computes as the row arrives, which is what lets the server interpret continuously without reading the larger data. Indexes over the vector, the position and the time support search by content, place and time, and NVIDIA cuVS ( RAPIDS Team, 2024 ) builds and searches the vector index on the GPU. The vision tokens and the latent are much larger and are read only when a memory is retrieved, so they are kept in an object store, and the row holds a reference to them.
paragraphs.zh: 车队记忆分为两部分，与每类数据的使用方式相匹配。 每个分段向共享的 Milvus 集合（Wang 等，2021）中添加一行，其中包含其 Cosmos-Embed1 向量、机器人的位姿、采集时间以及服务器在该行到达时计算出的任何判定结果，这使得服务器能够在不读取更大数据的情况下持续进行解读。 针对向量、位置和时间的索引支持按内容、地点和时间进行搜索，并且 NVIDIA cuVS（RAPIDS Team，2024）在 GPU 上构建和搜索向量索引。 视觉令牌和潜变量要大得多，并且只有在检索记忆时才会被读取，因此它们被保存在对象存储中，而该行保存对它们的引用。

paragraphs.en: ReMEmbR’s reference deployment runs Milvus on the robot ( Anwar et al., 2025 ) . Here, we centralize it on the on-premises server to offload database and index-serving work from robots, avoid duplicated fleet indexes and per-robot reconciliation, and provide the fleet a shared live database of memories to independently contribute to and query from.
paragraphs.zh: ReMEmbR 的参考部署方案是在机器人上运行 Milvus（Anwar 等，2025）。 在此，我们将其集中部署在本地服务器上，以便将数据库和索引服务工作从机器人上卸载，避免整个机群中出现重复的索引和每台机器人各自的对账操作，并为机群提供一个共享的实时记忆数据库，各机器人可以独立地向其贡献数据并从中查询。

paragraphs.en: Questions are answered on an on-premises server by a Nemotron-3-Nano-4B agent. As in ReMEmbR, the agent searches the index by content, position and time, and the entries it retrieves accumulate in its working memory. Each retrieved entry now holds a reference to its cached vision tokens in place of a caption, and a fourth tool lets the agent put a question of its own to the Cosmos3-Edge language decoder about any entry. The agent therefore decides both which moments to look at and what to ask about them.
paragraphs.zh: 问题由一个 Nemotron-3-Nano-4B 智能体在本地部署的服务器上作答。 与 ReMEmbR 一样，智能体按内容、位置和时间检索索引，其取回的条目会累积到工作记忆中。 现在每条被检索的条目都持有对其缓存视觉 token 的引用而非字幕，并且第四个工具允许智能体就任一条目向 Cosmos3-Edge 语言解码器提出自己的问题。 因此，智能体既要决定查看哪些时刻，也要决定针对这些时刻提出什么问题。

sents.en: The agent therefore decides both which moments to look at and what to ask about them.

paragraphs.en: This is where the server elaborates on demand . The decoder answers from the cached tokens alone (Fig. 4 ). It builds its usual prompt from the chat template and the question, and it places the stored vision tokens in the slot where freshly encoded video would normally go. This split turns an intermediate model output into a lasting memory. Edge–server partitioning such as Neurosurgeon ( Kang et al., 2017 ) chooses a split layer per request to reduce its latency or energy, and the intermediate output is discarded once that request is served. Here, the boundary sits at the model’s vision–language interface, and the robot’s tokens persist in fleet memory long after they are encoded. One set of tokens can answer any number of questions.
paragraphs.zh: 这正是服务器按需进行详细计算的地方。 解码器仅凭缓存的 token 就能回答问题（图 4）。 它根据聊天模板和问题构建通常的提示词，并将存储的视觉 token 放在通常存放新编码视频的槽位中。 这种划分把一个中间模型输出变成了持久的记忆。 诸如 Neurosurgeon（Kang 等，2017）这样的边缘–服务器切分方法会为每个请求选择一个切分层，以降低该请求的延迟或能耗，并且中间输出在该请求得到服务后即被丢弃。 而在这里，边界位于模型的视觉–语言接口处，机器人的 token 在编码完成很久之后仍保存在机群内存中。 一组 token 可以回答任意数量的问题。

paragraphs.en: We return to the blocked aisle example from the introduction. The first robot to pass the clutter stores a memory of it like any other clip, and whether the aisle ahead is occupied is already implicit in that memory’s embedding. When the live semantic map next refreshes, it finds that this embedding vector aligns more closely with those of descriptions of an occupied aisle than those of a clear one, and the aisle’s zone turns orange. The fleet manager can then take the blocked aisle into account when planning routes in that area. Further, an operator who wants to know what exactly is in the way can click the robot and read a description of what it saw, generated on the spot from the memory’s cached vision tokens. None of this changes the robots, which run the same iw.encode pipeline as in Section 4.1 . The server adds two cached text prototypes and a map service that queries the agent on a fixed clock, and the rest is Industrial ReMEmbR (Fig. 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们回到引言中通道被堵的例子。 第一个穿过杂乱区域的机器人会像存储其他片段一样存储一段记忆，而前方通道是否被占用已经隐含在该记忆的嵌入中。 当实时语义地图下次刷新时，它会发现该嵌入向量与「通道被占用」描述的嵌入的相似度高于与「通道畅通」描述的嵌入的相似度，于是该通道所在的区域变为橙色。 车队管理器随后在规划该区域路线时就能把被堵的通道纳入考量。 此外，想知道通道里具体挡了什么的操作员可以点击该机器人，读取一段从该记忆缓存视觉令牌即时生成的描述。 这一切都不需要改动机器人，它们仍运行与 4.1 节相同的 iw.encode 流程。 服务器只需增加两个缓存的文本原型和一个按固定周期查询智能体的地图服务，其余部分即为工业版 ReMEmbR（图 5）。

paragraphs.en: A single similarity score is a weak signal. A clip’s embedding describes the whole scene, including its background, colors and lighting, so its similarity to any short prompt is low, and the scores for the two outcomes end up close together. This score attenuation is a direct consequence of the average pooling applied to the Q-Former tokens in the Cosmos-Embed1 architecture. Because this pooling operation collapses all visual tokens into a single global vector, v encodes the entire scene thereby diluting the specific signals. By contrasting v against the two opposing, generalized prototypes, we isolate the relevant semantic axis and bypass the dilution caused by the global visual pooling. A fixed threshold on either score would be fragile, so the verdict compares the two directly. Their difference, 𝐯 ⊤ ​ ( 𝐩 occ − 𝐩 clr ) \mathbf{v}^{\top}(\mathbf{p}_{\mathrm{occ}}-\mathbf{p}_{\mathrm{clr}}) , cancels whatever the prototypes have in common, such as the aisle itself, and keeps only how much more the clip looks like an occupied aisle than a clear one.
paragraphs.zh: 单一相似度分数是一个微弱的信号。 视频片段的嵌入描述的是整个场景，包括其背景、颜色和光照，因此它与任何简短提示词的相似度都很低，最终两种结果的分数会非常接近。 这种分数衰减是 Cosmos-Embed1 架构中对 Q-Former token 施加平均池化的直接后果。 由于这种池化操作将所有视觉 token 压缩成单一的全局向量，v 便编码了整个场景，从而稀释了特定信号。 通过将 v 与两个对立的、泛化的原型进行对比，我们分离出相关的语义轴，并绕过了全局视觉池化造成的稀释。 对任一分数设置固定阈值都会很脆弱，因此判定逻辑直接对二者进行比较。 它们的差值 𝐯 ⊤ ​ ( 𝐩 occ − 𝐩 clr ) \mathbf{v}^{\top}(\mathbf{p}_{\mathrm{occ}}-\mathbf{p}_{\mathrm{clr}}) 会抵消两个原型共有的部分（例如过道本身），只保留该片段看起来更像被占用过道而非空旷过道的程度。

paragraphs.en: While updating the map does not strictly need the agent in this narrow case, since the verdict is already available with each memory, we maintain the agent as an adaptive natural language interface. It decides how to answer, relying on a robot’s latest memory or checking it against what other robots recorded in the same aisle shortly before. The map service only sends it a question, and a different question entails no further changes across the pipeline. We see traffic as the first layer of a multi-purpose semantic map of industrial sites, whose zones could eventually record whether a charging station is free, whether a dock is filling up, or whether a recognizable landmark is still where a navigation policy expects it. Building a dedicated classifier for each of these would mean new models, new memory fields and new robot software every time a unique need arose. With an agent exposing a natural language interface between the semantic map and the shared memory, each new need becomes a new question posed to the same interface.
paragraphs.zh: 在这个狭窄的场景下，更新地图其实并不严格需要智能体，因为判断结果已经随每条记忆一同可用，但我们仍将智能体保留为一个自适应的自然语言接口。 它决定如何作答，是依据机器人最新的记忆，还是将其与其他机器人在不久前于同一通道中记录的内容进行核对。 地图服务只是向它发送一个问题，而一个不同的问题不需要在整个流水线中做任何进一步的改动。 我们将交通状况视为工业场所多用途语义地图的第一层，该地图的区域最终可以记录充电站是否空闲、装卸口是否正在被占用，或某个可识别的地标是否仍在导航策略所预期的位置。 为其中每一项构建专门的分类器，意味着每当出现一个独特需求，就要新建模型、新增记忆字段并更新机器人软件。 有了智能体在语义地图与共享记忆之间提供自然语言接口，每个新需求都变成了向同一接口提出的一个新问题。

paragraphs.en: Upgraded ReMEmbR replaces all three models of ReMEmbR. Nemotron-3-Nano-4B takes over from Llama-3.1-8B as the agent, Cosmos3-Edge from VILA-1.5-13B as the captioner, and a Cosmos-Embed1 video index from the MxBai caption-text index. The pipeline around these models is unchanged, so any difference on NaVQA comes from the models, and swapping in one model at a time shows which model causes which difference. NaVQA ( Anwar et al., 2025 ) tests long-horizon memory over all seven CODa campus sequences, where each memory holds one three-second clip with its capture pose and time. We run three trials per configuration, each answering 67 yes/no questions, for 201 responses (Appendix B ). Retrieval recall is the fraction of annotated evidence segments that appear in any of the agent’s tool results, so it depends on both the index and the queries the agent writes. Reliability is measured by first-attempt parse failures , answers the evaluator cannot parse on the first try, and by unscorable answers , which stay unparsable after retries. Position errors are medians over parsed answers.
paragraphs.zh: 升级版 ReMEmbR 替换了 ReMEmbR 的全部三个模型。 Nemotron-3-Nano-4B 取代 Llama-3.1-8B 成为智能体，Cosmos3-Edge 取代 VILA-1.5-13B 成为描述器，Cosmos-Embed1 视频索引取代 MxBai 描述-文本索引。 这些模型周围的流水线保持不变，因此 NaVQA 上的任何差异都来自模型本身，每次只替换一个模型即可看出是哪个模型导致了哪种差异。 NaVQA（Anwar et al., 2025）在全部七条 CODa 校园序列上测试长时程记忆，其中每条记忆包含一个三秒片段及其拍摄位姿和时间。 我们对每个配置运行三次试验，每次回答 67 个是/否问题，共 201 个回答（附录 B）。 检索召回率是被标注证据片段出现在智能体工具结果中任意一个里的比例，因此它同时取决于索引和智能体编写的查询。 可靠性通过首次尝试解析失败（评估器第一次无法解析的回答）和无法评分的回答（重试后仍无法解析的回答）来衡量。 位置误差是对已解析回答取的中位数。

paragraphs.en: Each new model improves a different measure (Tab. 2 ). Nemotron is the one that makes answers reliable. Swapping it in alone cuts first-attempt parse failures from 20.7% to 16.2% and unscorable answers from 4.5% to 0.9%, whereas swapping in the captioner or the index instead raises first-attempt failures to 22.4% and 23.5%. The effect does not depend on what the agent reads. Across all four captioner–index pairs of Tab. 5 , Nemotron stays within 12.2–16.2% first-attempt failures against 20.7–23.5% for Llama, and within 0.9–1.9% unscorable answers against 3.6–5.5%. Nemotron has half the parameters of Llama, so this gain likely reflects its post-training for tool use and structured output rather than its size.

paragraphs.en: Recall, in contrast, follows the index. Replacing the caption-text index with Cosmos-Embed1 alone raises recall from 22.9% to 29.7%, the largest gain of any single swap, and the video index matches or improves recall for every agent–captioner pair. A caption-text index can find only what the captioner chose to mention, while the video index matches a question against the clip itself, and so it needs neither a caption nor a caption-text embedding stage. Industrial ReMEmbR relies on this property when it stops writing captions altogether.

paragraphs.en: Combined, the three models improve on original ReMEmbR in both reliability and recall. First-attempt parse failures fall from 20.7% to 13.8% and unscorable answers from 4.5% to 1.9%, relative reductions of about 33% and 58%, and median position error falls from 69.1 to 66.6 m. Recall rises from 22.9% to 24.6%, less than the index swap alone achieves. Because recall also depends on the agent’s queries, Nemotron lowers it by 2.3–5.9 points relative to Llama in every pair, and the full stack keeps only part of the index’s gain. In exchange, Nemotron lowers median position error by 7.7–11.9 m relative to Llama whenever it is paired with either new component.
paragraphs.zh: 三者结合后，三个模型在可靠性和召回率上都优于原始 ReMEmbR。 首次解析失败率从 20.7% 降至 13.8%，无法评分的回答从 4.5% 降至 1.9%，相对降幅分别约为 33% 和 58%，中位位置误差从 69.1 米降至 66.6 米。 召回率从 22.9% 升至 24.6%，低于仅更换索引所达到的水平。 由于召回率还取决于智能体的查询，在每一组对比中，Nemotron 相对于 Llama 都将其降低了 2.3–5.9 个百分点，因此完整系统只保留了索引增益的一部分。 作为交换，只要 Nemotron 与任一新组件搭配使用，其相对于 Llama 的中位位置误差就降低 7.7–11.9 米。

paragraphs.en: Upgraded ReMEmbR therefore finds more evidence and answers more reliably, yet it still captions every clip as it is written. The next question is whether Industrial ReMEmbR can drop that step without losing what the caption provided.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，升级版 ReMEmbR 能找到更多证据并更可靠地给出答案，但它仍然像原来那样为每个片段生成描述。 下一个问题是，工业版 ReMEmbR 能否省去这一步骤，同时不失去描述所带来的信息。

paragraphs.en: Industrial ReMEmbR stores Cosmos3-Edge vision tokens in place of a caption and splits the model at its vision–language boundary (Section 4 ). The split is only worthwhile if decoding from stored tokens gives the same answer as running the full model on the frame, and if elaborating a memory is fast enough to fit inside an agent’s answer. We test both on a separate run of 150 traffic frames (Appendix C ). The vision encoder encodes each frame once, and the language decoder answers three questions from the cached tokens. The same frames and questions also run through the unsplit model for comparison. All timings use one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPU.
paragraphs.zh: 工业级 ReMEmbR 用 Cosmos3-Edge 视觉token替代字幕描述，并在模型的视觉-语言边界处进行切分（第4节）。 只有当从存储的token解码能得到与在完整模型上运行该帧相同的答案，并且细化一段记忆的速度足够快、能容纳在智能体的回答时间内时，这种切分才有价值。 我们在另一次运行的150帧交通场景帧上对两者进行测试（附录C）。 视觉编码器对每帧编码一次，语言解码器从缓存的token回答三个问题。 同样的帧和问题也在未切分的模型上运行以作对比。 所有计时均使用一块 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPU。

paragraphs.en: The split model reproduces the full model exactly. Under greedy decoding, decoding from cached tokens produced the same text as the unsplit Cosmos3-Edge for all three questions on every frame, 450 of 450 cases, and tokens written to the object store and read back later decoded through the same path. Splitting the model therefore leaves its outputs unchanged, and a later question can be answered from memory as if the frame were still at hand.
paragraphs.zh: 拆分模型能够完全复现完整模型的结果。 在贪婪解码下，从缓存 token 进行解码所得的文本与未拆分的 Cosmos3-Edge 在所有帧上的三个问题中完全一致，450 个案例全部匹配，写入对象存储并稍后读回的 token 也通过相同路径解码。 因此，拆分模型不会改变其输出，后续问题可以凭记忆回答，就好像帧仍然在手边一样。

paragraphs.en: Encoding is paid once per memory and decoding once per question. paragraphs.en: Reconstructing a scene for human inspection works the same way. A five-frame 480 × \times 832 clip is stored as a 48 × 2 × 30 × 52 48\times 2\times 30\times 52 BF16 latent of 300 kB, one-twentieth of its uncompressed size; casting the FP32 encoder output to BF16 halves storage and changes the reconstruction metrics below by under 0.1% (Tab. 6 ), and the Wan2.2 decoder has a median reconstruction time of 1.76 s (Tab. 3 ). Reconstructions of the 150 frames reach 39.7 dB PSNR, 0.974 SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) and 0.0052 LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) , with the remaining differences mostly in fine textures and thin edges (Fig. 9 ). An operator who inspects a memory therefore sees a close reconstruction of the frames the robot recorded.
paragraphs.zh: 为人类检查重建场景的工作方式与此相同。 一个五帧 480 × \times 832 的片段被存储为 48 × 2 × 30 × 52 48\times 2\times 30\times 52 的 BF16 潜表示，大小为 300 kB，是其未压缩大小的二十分之一；将 FP32 编码器输出转换为 BF16 可使存储减半，且对下文重建指标的改变小于 0.1%（Tab. 6），Wan2.2 解码器的中位重建时间为 1.76 s（Tab. 3）。 150 帧的重建达到 39.7 dB PSNR、0.974 SSIM（Wang et al., 2004）和 0.0052 LPIPS（Zhang et al., 2018），剩余的差异主要出现在精细纹理和细边缘上（Fig. 9）。 因此，检查记忆的操作员看到的是机器人所记录帧的近似重建。

paragraphs.en: Industrial ReMEmbR moves encoding onto the robots and generation onto the questions, so its cost has an edge side and a server side, which we measure separately. Edge timings use warmed TensorRT 8.5.2 engines on a Jetson AGX Xavier with the inputs of Tab. 4 , and they include transfers between host and device (Appendix D.1 ). Server measurements use one RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPU unless stated otherwise. Where we extrapolate to a fleet, we assume one memory per robot every 12 s over an eight-hour day and mark the result as modeled (Appendix D.3 ). The live map’s 10 s poll interval is a separate setting (Section 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 工业级 ReMEmbR 将编码移到机器人上、将生成移到问题上，因此其成本分为边缘端和服务器端两部分，我们分别进行测量。 边缘端计时使用在 Jetson AGX Xavier 上预热好的 TensorRT 8.5.2 引擎，输入如表 4 所示，并包含主机与设备之间的传输（附录 D.1）。 除非另有说明，服务器端测量均使用一块 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 服务器版 GPU。 在外推到整个机群时，我们假设每台机器人每 12 秒生成一条记忆、每天运行八小时，并将该结果标注为建模值（附录 D.3）。 实时地图的 10 秒轮询间隔是一个单独的设置（第 5 节）。

We measure server load in GPU equivalents, the GPU time requested per second, so one equivalent keeps one GPU fully busy. paragraphs.en: The agent must also keep up as the map polls more robots at once. Original ReMEmbR serves its agent through Ollama, whose throughput in our deployment barely grows with concurrency. At an 8k context, Ollama with Q8_0 grows from 203 to 235 output tokens/s as concurrent requests rise from one to eight, while NIM in FP8 grows from 236 to 1,217 tokens/s, about five times Ollama’s throughput at eight requests (Fig. 13 ). Ollama’s scheduler serves the Nemotron architecture families, including Nemotron-3-Nano-4B, one request at a time ( Morgan, 2026 ) . We measure how many robots the agent can serve under load. With one GPU serving the agent, 95% of map updates finish within 20 s for 24 robots polling every 10 s, and two GPUs serve at least 48 (Appendix D.2 ). The map therefore costs about 0.042 GPU equivalents per robot, or 4.2 for 100 robots. With 10% of memories described, the server’s generation load for 100 robots is about 5.2 GPU equivalents, still below the 36.25 of captioning alone, although captioning is costed unbatched here and batching it would narrow the gap. Because most of this load comes from map polling, the poll interval outweighs the description fraction as the main lever on server cost at fleet scale.
paragraphs.zh: 当地图同时轮询更多机器人时，智能体也必须能够跟上负载。 原版 ReMEmbR 通过 Ollama 为其智能体提供服务，而在我们的部署中，Ollama 的吞吐量几乎不随并发增加而增长。 在 8k 上下文长度下，随着并发请求从 1 个增加到 8 个，使用 Q8_0 量化格式的 Ollama 输出速度从 203 token/s 提升至 235 token/s，而 FP8 的 NIM 则从 236 token/s 提升至 1,217 token/s，在 8 个并发请求下约为 Ollama 吞吐量的 5 倍（图 13）。 Ollama 的调度器对包括 Nemotron-3-Nano-4B 在内的 Nemotron 架构系列模型一次只能处理一个请求（Morgan, 2026）。 我们测量了智能体在负载下能够服务的机器人数量。 在使用一块 GPU 服务智能体的情况下，对于每 10 秒轮询一次的 24 台机器人，95% 的地图更新能在 20 秒内完成；两块 GPU 则至少可以服务 48 台机器人（附录 D.2）。 因此，每台机器人的地图成本约为 0.042 个 GPU 等效算力，100 台机器人则约为 4.2 个。 在 10% 的记忆需要描述的情况下，服务 100 台机器人时服务器的生成负载约为 5.2 个 GPU 等效算力，仍低于仅字幕生成所需的 36.25；不过此处的字幕生成成本是按非批量方式计算的，若采用批处理则会缩小两者差距。 由于这部分负载大部分来自地图轮询，在机群规模下，轮询间隔相比描述比例是影响服务器成本的主要杠杆。

Search reads the index and runs on the GPU. Within Milvus ( Wang et al., 2021 ) , the cuVS GPU exact index ( RAPIDS Team, 2024 ) serves 910 exact queries per second at 32 concurrent queries, compared with 47 for CPU exact search, with identical results (Fig. 14 ). paragraphs.en: The live map of Section 5 reads a traffic verdict directly from each memory’s Cosmos-Embed1 vector, without a detector or a captioner. The map is only useful if this verdict is accurate and if the agent passes it on unchanged, so we compare it with caption-based memories under the same agent. The test set is a deterministic, contiguous warehouse simulation of 914 frames, each stored as a single-frame memory with its pose and time and paired with one yes/no question about traffic ahead. Labels come from the simulator’s record of other agents in the zone ahead of the robot, giving 607 traffic frames and 307 clear ones. Traffic is the majority class, so always answering “traffic” already scores 66.4% accuracy. We therefore report balanced accuracy , the mean of traffic recall and clear recall, on which that baseline scores 50.0%.
paragraphs.zh: 第5节的实时地图直接从每条记忆的 Cosmos-Embed1 向量读取交通判定，无需检测器或描述生成器。 只有当该判定准确、且智能体将其原样传递时，这张地图才有用，因此我们在同一智能体下将其与基于描述的记忆进行比较。 测试集是一个确定性的、连续的914帧仓库仿真，每一帧都作为带有其位姿和时间的单帧记忆存储，并配有一个关于前方交通的是/否问题。 标签来自仿真器对机器人前方区域内其他智能体的记录，得到607个交通帧和307个畅通帧。 交通是多数类，因此始终回答“有交通”就已达到66.4%的准确率。 因此我们报告平衡准确率，即交通召回率与畅通召回率的均值，在该指标上该基线得分为50.0%。

paragraphs.en: The three memories differ only in what each frame writes. The embedding verdict scores the frame’s Cosmos-Embed1 vector against the occupied and clear prototypes of Section 5 , with no tuned threshold. For detection , Cosmos3-Edge lists the obstacles in the forward path as labeled bounding boxes, and for description it writes a free-text description of the scene, both with reasoning enabled. Before answering, the agent must search memory by the frame’s position, so it reads every representation from the same memory row. A frame counts toward a representation’s coverage when that representation produced usable content for it. Prompts and prototypes are listed in Appendix F , and protocols in Appendix E .
paragraphs.zh: 三种记忆仅在每一帧各自写入的内容上有所不同。 嵌入判定将这一帧的 Cosmos-Embed1 向量与第 5 节的占用原型和空闲原型进行比对，不使用任何调优的阈值。 在检测任务中，Cosmos3-Edge 以带标签的边界框形式列出前向路径中的障碍物；在描述任务中，它写入一段自由文本的场景描述，两者均在启用推理的情况下完成。 在回答之前，智能体必须按该帧的位置检索记忆，因此它会从同一个记忆行中读取每一种表示。 当某种表示为某一帧产生了可用的内容时，该帧才计入这种表示的覆盖率。 提示词和原型列于附录 F，协议列于附录 E。

paragraphs.en: The embedding verdict reaches 71.3% balanced accuracy, 6.0 points above detection, the best caption-based memory, and it is the only representation that covers all 914 frames, against 844 for detection and 902 for description (Fig. 12 ). The caption arms are scored only on the frames they cover, so counting dropped frames as errors would only widen this margin. The two caption-based memories fail in opposite directions. Detection finds traffic in 88.4% of traffic frames but recognizes only 42.3% of clear frames, so its 72.7% accuracy, slightly above the verdict’s 72.1%, mostly reflects the majority class. Description errs the other way, with 91.1% clear recall and only 27.1% traffic recall. The verdict balances the two classes, with 73.8% traffic recall and 68.7% clear recall (Tab. 13 ).
paragraphs.zh: 嵌入式判定达到 71.3% 的平衡准确率，比检测高出 6.0 个百分点，优于基于字幕的记忆，并且它是唯一覆盖全部 914 帧的表示，而检测覆盖 844 帧、描述覆盖 902 帧（图 12）。 字幕分支仅在其覆盖的帧上进行评分，因此把丢失帧计为错误只会进一步扩大这一差距。 两种基于字幕的记忆以相反的方向失败。 检测在 88.4% 的交通帧中发现了交通，但仅识别出 42.3% 的畅通帧，因此其 72.7% 的准确率（略高于判定的 72.1%）主要反映了多数类别。 描述则以相反的方式出错，畅通帧召回率达 91.1%，而交通帧召回率仅为 27.1%。 判定则在两类之间取得平衡，交通帧召回率为 73.8%，畅通帧召回率为 68.7%（表 13）。

paragraphs.en: New uses of the same memory. The agent can already locate any landmark that any robot has seen, yet it uses that knowledge only to answer questions. Recast as semantic subgoals, such as “pass the blue loading bay, then turn left at the marked crossing,” that knowledge could guide a robot along routes it has never driven, drawing on what other robots have already observed. The live map’s zone verdicts can play the same role for fleet scheduling. RobotFleet ( Gupta et al., 2025 ) allocates subtasks across a heterogeneous fleet from a shared world state of declarative statements and replans when a robot reports something new. An occupied zone can update that state as soon as its memory arrives, and the agent can be asked what is blocking the zone before the next allocation.
paragraphs.zh: 同一记忆的新用法。 该智能体已经能够定位任何机器人见过的任何地标，但它仅利用这些知识来回答问题。 将这些知识重构为语义子目标，例如“经过蓝色装货区，然后在标记的路口左转”，它就可以借鉴其他机器人已经观察到的情况，引导机器人沿着从未行驶过的路线行进。 实时地图的区域判定可以在车队调度中发挥同样的作用。 RobotFleet（Gupta 等人，2025）从由陈述性语句构成的共享世界状态出发，在异构车队之间分配子任务，并在某个机器人报告新情况时重新规划。 一旦某个被占用区域的记忆到达，就可以更新该状态，并且在下一次分配之前可以向智能体询问是什么阻塞了该区域。

paragraphs.en: Fleet memory as training data. Each robot already encodes its clips into the vision tokens and video latents that compatible Cosmos3 models consume ( NVIDIA, 2026a ) , so routine fleet operation doubles as distributed preprocessing for training. This costly visual encoding is offloaded to edge devices across the fleet, paid once per memory, and amortized over every epoch and every compatible model trained from the cached representations, without transferring raw video or re-running the encoders (Appendix G ). A world model trained on these latents could become a learned simulator of the site, replaying recorded scenes under alternative robot behaviors to show what would have happened had a robot taken another aisle, therefore translating failed rollouts into successful ones and distilling back to deployed policies and closing the flywheel. Fine-tuning the language decoder on the cached vision tokens could teach it the site’s own objects and terminology. Fine-tuning Cosmos-Embed1 with location-aware captioning objectives, as in LocCa ( Wan et al., 2024 ) and SigLIP 2 ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) , could also strengthen the spatial awareness that physical AI tasks require, thereby improving the balanced accuracy on traffic verdicts.
paragraphs.zh: 将集群记忆作为训练数据。 每台机器人已经将其视频片段编码为兼容的 Cosmos3 模型所消费的视觉 token 与视频潜变量（ NVIDIA, 2026a ），因此日常的集群运行可兼作训练用的分布式预处理。 这种代价高昂的视觉编码被卸载到整个集群的边缘设备上，每条记忆只需支付一次，并可在从缓存表征训练的每个 epoch 和每个兼容模型上摊销，而无需传输原始视频或重新运行编码器（Appendix G ）。 在这些潜变量上训练的世界模型可以成为该场所的学习型模拟器，通过替代的机器人行为回放已记录的场景，展示如果机器人走了另一条通道会发生什么，从而将失败的 rollout 转化为成功的 rollout，并蒸馏回已部署的策略，闭合飞轮。 在缓存的视觉 token 上对语言解码器进行微调，可以教会它该场所自身的物体与术语。 按照 LocCa（ Wan et al., 2024 ）和 SigLIP 2（ Tschannen et al., 2025 ）的方式，使用位置感知描述目标对 Cosmos-Embed1 进行微调，还可以增强物理 AI 任务所需的空间感知能力，从而提高通行判定的平衡准确率。

paragraphs.en: A cheaper memory at every stage. On the robot, the general-purpose video–text embedder answers the traffic question with two dot products but dominates encoding time. An embedder specialized for industrial scenes and distilled into a compact backbone such as SigLIP 2 ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) could encode faster on the edge and sharpen every prompt-based check on factory and warehouse vocabulary. On the server, the edge deployment expertise behind our encoders could yield a leaner agent, pruned, quantized and distilled from open models, that answers map polls with fewer calls and tokens. In storage, every memory is kept in full, so the store grows linearly, reaching 3.9 TB per month for 100 robots at the modeled write interval (Tab. 12 ). Much like human episodic memory, fleet memory could consolidate routine observations of the same place while keeping surprises in full, so that storage grows with the site’s rate of change rather than with fleet operating hours.
paragraphs.zh: 每个阶段都采用更便宜的存储。 在机器人端，通用视频-文本嵌入器只需两个点积即可回答交通问题，但编码时间占主导。 一个针对工业场景特化并蒸馏到 SigLIP 2（Tschannen et al., 2025）等紧凑骨干网络中的嵌入器，可以在边缘端更快地编码，并使每一个基于提示词的检查在工厂与仓储词汇上更加精准。 在服务器端，我们编码器背后的边缘部署专长可以造就一个更精简的智能体，它从开放模型经过剪枝、量化和蒸馏而来，能以更少的调用和令牌回答地图轮询。 在存储端，每条记忆都被完整保留，因此存储量线性增长，在所建模的写入间隔下，100 台机器人每月达到 3.9 TB（表 12）。 与人类情景记忆类似，车队记忆可以在完整保留意外事件的同时，对同一地点的日常观测进行整合，从而使存储增长取决于场地的变化速率，而非车队的运行时长。

paragraphs.en: The physical world as an attack surface. Text that the decoder reads from a scene enters the agent’s context like any other content, so a sign or a screen in view of a camera becomes an input the agent might obey, a physical form of prompt injection. As the agent gains authority over the fleet, perception must be treated as untrusted data. iw.shield, a protection layer under development, is our first step toward agents that can read the world without taking malicious orders from it.
paragraphs.zh: 物理世界作为攻击面。 解码器从场景中读取的文本会像其他任何内容一样进入智能体的上下文，因此摄像头视野内的一块标牌或一块屏幕就成了智能体可能服从的输入，这是提示注入的物理形式。 随着智能体获得对整个车队的权限，感知必须被视为不可信数据。iw.shield 是一个正在开发中的防护层，是我们迈向「能读取世界、却不会从世界接受恶意指令」的智能体的第一步。

paragraphs.en: We present Industrial ReMEmbR , a shared fleet memory that decouples observation encoding from on-demand interpretation. Each robot encodes a clip once into a retrieval embedding, vision tokens, and a video latent while retaining raw camera frames onboard. These representations support semantic retrieval, live traffic mapping, scene description, and reconstruction. We derive traffic classifications directly from retrieval embeddings at encoding time and generate scene descriptions and reconstructions only when needed. Encoding, storage, mapping, and interpretation operate as independent services, allowing multiple applications to reuse each observation and individual models to be replaced independently.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Industrial ReMEmbR，这是一种共享车队记忆，将观测编码与按需解读解耦。 每台机器人将一段视频片段一次性编码为检索嵌入、视觉 token 和视频潜变量，同时在机载保留原始相机帧。 这些表示支持语义检索、实时交通建图、场景描述和重建。 我们在编码时直接从检索嵌入推导交通分类，并且只在需要时才生成场景描述和重建。 编码、存储、建图和解读作为独立服务运行，使多个应用可以复用每次观测，并允许各个模型被独立替换。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation demonstrates the benefits of deferred description and validates key components of the architecture. Deferring caption generation removes text generation from the memory-write path. Video-based indexing matches or improves retrieval recall in every matched comparison, and cached-token decoding reproduces the unsplit Cosmos3-Edge output in all 450 tests. On full NaVQA, the updated model stack reduces first-attempt parse failures from 20.7% to 13.8% and unparsable answers from 4.5% to 1.9% with an agent half the parameter size. At a modeled 12 s write interval, description demand for 100 robots is 1.04 GPU equivalents when 10% of memories are described, compared with 36.25 GPU equivalents for captioning every memory. Across 914 simulated warehouse frames, embedding-based traffic classification achieves 71.3% balanced accuracy, exceeding the best reasoning-enabled caption-based alternative by 6.0 percentage points.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估展示了延迟描述的优势，并验证了架构的关键组件。 延迟字幕生成将文本生成从内存写入路径中移除。 基于视频的索引在所有匹配的比较中匹配或提高了检索召回率，且缓存令牌解码在全部 450 次测试中复现了未拆分的 Cosmos3-Edge 输出。 在完整的 NaVQA 上，更新后的模型栈将首次解析失败率从 20.7% 降至 13.8%，将无法解析的答案比例从 4.5% 降至 1.9%，同时智能体的参数规模仅为原来的一半。 在建模的 12 秒写入间隔下，当 10% 的记忆被描述时，100 台机器人的描述需求为 1.04 个 GPU 等效值，而每条记忆都生成字幕则需要 36.25 个 GPU 等效值。 在 914 帧模拟仓库图像上，基于嵌入的交通分类达到 71.3% 的平衡准确率，比最佳的基于字幕且启用推理的替代方案高出 6.0 个百分点。

sents.en: Across 914 simulated warehouse frames, embedding-based traffic classification achieves 71.3% balanced accuracy, exceeding the best reasoning-enabled caption-based alternative by 6.0 percentage points.

paragraphs.en: Further engineering is required for production deployment. Cosmos-Embed1, the slowest encoder on Jetson AGX Xavier, is our first target for TensorRT optimization and fine-tuning, while agent provisioning must account for the map-update workload and polling cadence. We plan to extend the system to congestion-aware fleet planning, semantic guidance for navigation policies, and continuous curation of deployment data for model fine-tuning. We will also investigate deploying agents on robot edge devices, reorganizing encoding components on the robot to obfuscate people from memories directly on the robots’ volatile memory, and developing iw.shield to protect the system against cyberattacks. The broader contribution is a reusable memory architecture through which a fleet’s collective experience can support an expanding range of applications as models, tasks, and warehouse conditions evolve.
paragraphs.zh: 若要投入生产部署，还需要进一步的工程工作。 Cosmos-Embed1 是 Jetson AGX Xavier 上最慢的编码器，是我们进行 TensorRT 优化与微调的首要目标，而智能体的配置必须考虑地图更新负载与轮询节奏。 我们计划将该系统扩展至拥塞感知的机队规划、面向导航策略的语义引导，以及为模型微调持续整理部署数据。 我们还将研究在机器人边缘设备上部署智能体、在机器人上重新组织编码组件以直接在机器人的易失性存储中使人员信息从记忆中模糊化，以及开发 iw.shield 以保护系统免受网络攻击。 更广泛的贡献是一套可复用的记忆架构，随着模型、任务和仓库条件的演进，机队的集体经验可以借助该架构支持不断扩展的应用范围。

paragraphs.en: Agent loop. Nemotron-3-Nano-4B may call tools for up to three rounds, with several calls per round, before a final step writes a structured JSON answer with text, yes/no, position, time and duration fields. Each search returns the k k nearest memories ( k = 5 k=5 in the NaVQA runs). An answer that fails to parse is regenerated, up to three attempts in total. In deployment, NVIDIA NIM serves the agent in FP8 with a 16k-token context and a 4,096-token output limit, and removes the reasoning trace before tool calls are parsed. The describe tool decodes greedily from the cached tokens with at most 512 new tokens. Tool signatures and the answer fields are listed in Appendix F.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体循环。 Nemotron-3-Nano-4B 最多可进行三轮工具调用，每轮可多次调用，最后一步会写出包含文本、是/否、位置、时间和时长字段的结构化 JSON 答案。 每次搜索返回 k k 条最近的记忆（在 NaVQA 实验中 k = 5 k=5）。 无法解析的答案会被重新生成，最多总共尝试三次。 在部署中，NVIDIA NIM 以 FP8 精度为该智能体提供服务，上下文为 16k token，输出上限为 4,096 token，并在解析工具调用之前移除推理轨迹。 describe 工具从缓存的 token 中以贪心方式解码，最多生成 512 个新 token。 工具签名和答案字段列于附录 F.3 中。

paragraphs.en: Describe-on-demand run. In a separate 150-frame run, each frame is encoded once by the Cosmos3-Edge vision encoder, and its cached tokens are decoded with three prompts: the detection prompt of Appendix F.1 (at most 256 new tokens), a general scene-description request (512) and a one-word yes/no question (16). Decoding is greedy with reasoning disabled, and each prompt gets a single attempt. The same frame and prompt are also run through the unsplit model. Two outputs match when the decoded strings are equal after trimming surrounding whitespace; all 450 frame–prompt pairs match. Times are wall-clock after one warm-up and include tokenization and image preprocessing.
paragraphs.zh: 按需描述式运行。 在另一次 150 帧的运行中，每帧由 Cosmos3-Edge 视觉编码器编码一次，其缓存的 token 用三个提示词解码：附录 F.1 的检测提示词（最多 256 个新 token）、一个通用场景描述请求（512）和一个单词的是/否问题（16）。 解码采用贪婪策略且禁用推理，每个提示词只尝试一次。 相同的帧和提示词也在未拆分模型上运行。 当解码后的字符串在去除首尾空白后相等时，即认为两个输出匹配；全部 450 个帧–提示词对均匹配。 时间为一次预热后的墙钟时间，并包含分词和图像预处理。

paragraphs.en: Caption arms. The Cosmos3-Edge detection and description arms run at temperature 0 with reasoning enabled and 2,048 output tokens each. Detection returns one JSON array of {label, bbox_2d} objects in normalized 0 to 1000 coordinates. A response that does not parse, or has the wrong keys, a generic label or an out-of-range or misordered box, is re-asked with the shorter correction prompt, for up to three attempts in total, and the frame is dropped if all three fail. Severity follows from the number of validated boxes: none is clear, one is low and two or more is high. Description asks for one sentence of at most 40 words. A description whose reasoning was cut off, or that exceeds the length limit, is dropped. The prompts are in Appendix F.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 标注手臂。 Cosmos3-Edge 检测与描述手臂均在温度 0 下运行，开启推理，每个手臂的输出 token 数为 2,048。 检测返回一个由 {label, bbox_2d} 对象组成的 JSON 数组，坐标为归一化的 0 到 1000。 无法解析的响应，或键名错误、标签过于宽泛、框越界或顺序错乱的响应，会用较简短纠正提示词重新询问，总共最多重试三次，若三次全部失败则丢弃该帧。 严重程度取决于通过验证的框的数量：无框为 clear，一个为 low，两个及以上为 high。 描述要求生成一句不超过 40 个词的句子。 推理被截断或超出长度限制的描述会被丢弃。 提示词见附录 F.1。
